en.headline: Police and Customs seize 4 million illicit cigarettes in Sai Kung
en.dek: Two anti-smuggling operations at Ah Kung Wan and Lobster Bay recovered cigarettes worth about HK$18 million; four speedboats fled towards mainland waters.
body: Marine Police and Customs officers seized about four million suspected illicit cigarettes with an estimated market value of HK$18 million in two early-morning operations along the Sai Kung coast on Monday.

The joint action by Marine Police Regional Task Force units and Customs Marine Investigation Division targeted suspected smuggling activity. Officers spotted two unlit speedboats at Ah Kung Wan and another two at Lobster Bay, where men were transferring cargo onto waiting trucks on shore.

When officers moved in, the men boarded the speedboats and fled. A chase followed but all four craft left Hong Kong waters to the southeast, heading towards the mainland. Two trucks suspected of involvement were detained. Customs is continuing the investigation.
Under the Dutiable Commodities Ordinance and the amended smoking control legislation, dealing in untaxed tobacco carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years’ imprisonment.

zh.headline: 水警海關西貢反走私檢400萬支私煙
zh.dek: 亞公灣及龍蝦灣兩宗行動檢獲市值約1800萬元懷疑私煙，四艘快艇逃往內地水域，兩輛涉案貨車被扣查。
body: 水警及海關人員周一凌晨在西貢水域一帶展開反走私行動，偵破兩宗案件，共檢獲約400萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約1800萬元，應課稅值約1300萬元。
水警總區特遣隊、港外區及東分區特遣隊聯同海關海域行動課人員，在亞公灣及龍蝦灣岸邊各發現兩艘沒有亮起航行燈的快艇，並有男子將貨物搬上貨車。人員採取行動時，涉案男子登上快艇逃走。
人員展開追截，惟四艘快艇最終逃離香港東南面水域，往內地方向逃去。兩輛懷疑涉案貨車被扣查，案件由海關繼續跟進。
根據《應課稅品條例》及控煙法例，處理、管有、售賣或購買私煙最高可被判罰款200萬元及監禁7年。
